description: This file provides utility functions for API interactions, including obtaining the backend base URL, creating chained abort controllers, and making fetch requests with timeout and abort support.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Resolves and returns the backend base URL, prioritizing the environment variable REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL and defaulting to 'http://localhost:3001'.

methods.name: createChainedAbortController(callerSignal)
methods.description: Creates an AbortController that aborts if either the caller's abort signal or the internal controller is aborted.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, { baseUrl, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, signal, ...options } = {})
methods.description: Fetch wrapper that combines timeout and abort capabilities, constructing the request URL and handling abort logic.

ctags.name: apiFetch
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetch(path, { baseUrl, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, signal, ...optio/
